description: Install (or with check:true only report) a verified standalone toolchain: board platform, compiler, uploader and the project locked libraries (iterb), plus a report of the board iterb simulator. Idempotent; works without the desktop app.

board.description: Board id (e.g. arduino-uno, esp32-devkit, esp32-c3-generic); defaults to the project board.

check.description: Only report what is missing; download nothing.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the IterxAI project directory (contains iterx.json). Defaults to the server cwd.

source.description: auto (default: toolchain + libraries + simulator capability report) or firmware (compile/upload toolchain and project libraries only).

name: ensure_toolchain
